Game Overview

At its heart, Quarantine Zombies is a zombie game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Quarantine Zombies is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Quarantine Zombies?

Quarantine Zombies is a free zombie game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Quarantine Zombies free to play?

Yes, Quarantine Zombies is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
